scope: Isolated diagnosis of the browser clipboard permission path used by the current renderer; product repair remains planned

actual_write_permission_probe.api: navigator.clipboard.write with a text/plain ClipboardItem whose Blob promise never resolves
actual_write_permission_probe.error_message: Failed to execute 'write' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied.

conclusion: The renderer relies on browser clipboard writing while the host rejects its write permission. Permission query results alone do not demonstrate actual write access. Route product text copying through a restricted main-process clipboard entry and verify its completed write separately.
